title: La cena del domingo
blurbEn: The whole family at the grandparents' table. Almost every word here is one you already know.
body:
Los domingos toda la familia come en casa de mis abuelos.

Mi abuela cocina desde la mañana. Su receta favorita es el pollo con ajo y aceite.

Yo la ayudo en la cocina. Pongo la mesa y preparo la ensalada.

A todos nos gusta esta cena. Hablamos mucho, comemos despacio y nadie mira el ordenador.

Para mí es el mejor momento de la semana.
translationEn:
On Sundays the whole family eats at my grandparents' house.

My grandmother cooks from the morning onwards. Her favourite recipe is chicken with garlic and oil.

I help her in the kitchen. I set the table and prepare the salad.

We all like this dinner. We talk a lot, we eat slowly and nobody looks at the computer.

For me it is the best moment of the week.

cocina.note: Here it is the verb. Two lines later 'la cocina' is the kitchen — same spelling, different word.

la.note: 'Yo la ayudo' — 'la' stands in for 'mi abuela'. Not the article 'the' this time.

nos.note: Same pattern as 'me gusta', but for a group: 'a todos nos gusta'.
